scope: Read-only target-host, device, ROS dependency, launch-contract and fail-closed configuration audit

host.platform: Windows desktop with Ubuntu-22.04 under WSL2

dependency_notes: The project currently uses its guarded pymavlink bridge for the UAV control contract; installed MAVROS is not the active SIL bridge.
The AT9S Pro production path is receiver to Pixhawk RC_CHANNELS telemetry, so ros-humble-joy is not required unless a separate USB/gamepad teleoperation path is commissioned.

hunter_base must be installed and version-pinned on the target Jetson image, then validated against the actual Hunter controller and CAN adapter; installing it only in desktop WSL would not constitute HIL evidence.
physical_hil_blockers: Deploy and pin the software image on the target Jetson and repeat CPU/GPU/thermal/network endurance tests.
Attach Pixhawk/Cube over a stable by-id serial endpoint and verify parameter attestation, RC takeover, mode/LAND ACKs, telemetry loss and battery/EKF/geofence failsafes with propellers removed.
Install and pin hunter_base on Jetson, attach can0 to the Hunter controller, verify CAN bitrate, command sign, wheel odometry, steering limits, command timeout and physical E-stop with wheels lifted.
Connect the independent E-stop/PLC heartbeat and prove the 200 ms safety-chain deadline with instrumented fault injection.
Connect four independent docking contact/lock feedback channels and verify stale, disagreement, timeout and loss-of-contact behavior on a non-flight fixture.
Commission calibrated camera, 2D/3D LiDAR, stereo/depth, ultrasonic, IMU and localization drivers against the real topic/QoS/frame contracts.
Survey the site map, geofence, no-fly and height-limit zones; replace the deliberately UNCOMMISSIONED real mission profile and obtain review approval.
Run staged bench, tethered, closed-field, endurance and repeated-docking validation before any commercial release claim.
conclusion: The repository and launch/configuration contracts are ready to enter bench HIL. Physical HIL, field safety validation and certification are not complete because the required target hardware is not connected to this host.
